mapper.select: /* ScOperPrfmncMapper.retrieveScWtngList */ SELECT A.PSG_FLOW_DATA_CRT_DT, A.TMNL_ID, A.CHKN_ISL_CD, A.FCLT_NM, A.FCLT_TYPE_CD, NVL(A.WTNG_LINE_LEN, 0) AS WTNG_LINE_LEN, NVL(A.DALY_ACML_PSG_CNT, 0) AS DALY_ACML_PSG_CNT FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_PSG_WTNG_INFO A WHERE 1 = 1 -- 여객흐름자료생성일시는 yyyyMMddHHmm 문자열이자 PK 선두라 앞자리 범위로 자른다 AND A.PSG_FLOW_DATA_CRT_DT BETWEEN #{ymd} || '0000' AND #{ymd} || '2359' AND A.FCLT_TYPE_CD = 'SC' ORDER BY A.TMNL_ID, A.FCLT_NM, A.PSG_FLOW_DATA_CRT_DT
